set.body: Scope: (9) fixture-freezing tooling + adjudication protocol (docs/plans/2026-08-28-m1-fixture-adjudication-protocol.md or similar under docs/plans/), frozen selection set >=8 stories / >=3 families built independently of every tested channel — story texts must be public-domain data files (never agent-generated text; WOG never selects); (10) embed-bench JVM module per spike spec rev 2 (strict recall at level, level confusion, summary accuracy, blend coverage, candidate burden, MRR, macro CIs, gate correctness, separated open-world reports, three-clock panels). Paths: docs/plans/**, embed-bench/**, fixtures/src/main/resources/** (new frozen data only), build.sbt (embed-bench entry only — post on coordination before editing; preflight). No portable module gains a JVM-only or sibling dependency. Gate: embedBench/test green; compileAll all platforms; scalafmtCheckAll. Independence audit of the frozen set is a separate bead assigned to a Codex actor (W4: claude builds, codex audits). Post a sub-bead decomposition within 30 min of claiming; post candidate SHA + evidence before merging; chief acks.
set.title: M1 W4(9)+W4(10): frozen adjudicated fixture protocol + embed-bench harness (defaults only from this evidence)
